SELECT max(try_cast(tax_refund_fytd_amt AS double)) AS millions FROM govblock_treasury.income_tax_refunds_issued WHERE record_date = '2019-09-30' AND tax_refund_type LIKE '%Individual%'
Which computed materials are the stiffest by bulk modulus?
SELECT formula_pretty, try_cast(regexp_extract(bulk_modulus, 'vrh=([0-9.]+)', 1) AS double) AS bulk_modulus_gpa FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
Does NSF make more standard grants or continuing grants?
SELECT value, count(*) AS awards FROM govblock_grants.nsf_awards GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which Puerto Rico municipalities have the most mapped buildings in the PR100 study?
SELECT addrcity, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_energy.oedi_pr100_setbacks_buildings WHERE addrcity IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many materials does the Materials Project rate as thermodynamically stable?
SELECT count(*) AS stable FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary WHERE cast(is_stable AS varchar) = 'true'
Which balancing authorities oversee the most power plants?
SELECT balancing_authority_name, count(DISTINCT plant_code) AS plants FROM govblock_energy.eia860_plant_y_sheet_plant WHERE balancing_authority_name <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much has health care employment grown since 2015?
SELECT year, value AS jobs_thousands FROM govblock_labor.bls_ce_data WHERE series_id = 'CES6562000001' AND period = 'M12' AND cast(year AS varchar) IN ('2015', '2024') ORDER BY year
Which states have the most hospitals enrolled in Medicare?
SELECT state, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cms_hospital_enrollments WHERE state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much did section 527 political groups report raising in July 2024?
SELECT sum(try_cast(column15 AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_nonprofits.pol_org_8872_contributions WHERE substr(cast(column16 AS varchar), 1, 6) = '202407'
Which states logged the most site visits to water systems in 2024?
SELECT substr(pwsid, 1, 2) AS state, count(*) AS visits FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_site_visits WHERE substr(visit_date, 7, 4) = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of formal Clean Air Act enforcement actions are taken by EPA itself?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN state_epa_flag = 'E' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_environment.echo_icis_air_formal_actions
Which law schools have educated the most judges?

SELECT s.name, count(DISTINCT e.person_id) AS judges FROM govblock_courts.people_db_educations AS e JOIN govblock_courts.people_db_schools AS s ON s.id = e.school_id WHERE e.degree_level = 'jd' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many megawatts did dual-fuel plants supply to New York's grid on average in 2023?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(gen_mw AS double))) AS avg_mw FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_fuel_mix_rtfuelmix WHERE fuel_category = 'Dual Fuel' AND substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2023'
Where do the fewest adults visit a dentist, by county?

SELECT concat(locationname, ', ', stateabbr) AS county, try_cast(data_value AS double) AS percent FROM govblock_health.cdc_places_county WHERE measureid = 'DENTAL' AND datavaluetypeid = 'AgeAdjPrv' AND year = '2022' ORDER BY 2 ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many deposited substance records point to aspirin?
SELECT count(*) AS substances FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_sid WHERE c0 = '2244'
Which kinds of power plants have the most operating capacity on the national map?
SELECT type, sum(try_cast(oper_cap AS double)) AS capacity_mw FROM govblock_siting.hifld_power_plants WHERE status = 'OP' AND try_cast(oper_cap AS double) > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How is ethanol written as a SMILES string?
SELECT c1 AS smiles FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_smiles WHERE c0 = '702'
Which states and countries are home to the most 13F filers?
SELECT filingmanager_stateorcountry AS place, count(DISTINCT filingmanager_name) AS managers FROM govblock_sec.sec_13f_coverpage GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Were there more road deaths in 2019, before the pandemic, or in 2021?
SELECT year, sum(try_cast(fatals AS integer)) AS deaths FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE cast(year AS varchar) IN ('2019', '2021') GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which kinds of toxicity prompt drug warnings most often?
SELECT warning_class, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_drug_warning WHERE warning_class IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Were more patent applications filed in 2015 or in 2023?
SELECT substr(filing_date, 6, 4) AS year, count(*) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.patex_application_data_25 WHERE substr(filing_date, 6, 4) IN ('2015', '2023') GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
How are hospitals enrolled in Medicare organised as legal entities?
SELECT organization_type_structure, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cms_hospital_enrollments WHERE organization_type_structure IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the molecular formula of nicotine?
SELECT c1 AS formula FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_mass WHERE c0 = '89594'
Which states filed the most returns with incomes of $200,000 or more for 2021?
Income by ZIP Code and County
SELECT state, sum(try_cast(n1 AS double)) AS returns FROM govblock_tax.soi_zip_zpallagi WHERE cast(agi_stub AS varchar) = '6' AND source_file LIKE '%/21zpallagi%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of 2022's fatal crashes happened after dark?
SELECT round(100.0 * count_if(lgt_condname LIKE 'Dark%') / count(*), 1) AS pct_dark FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2022'
Which states had the highest unemployment rate in the 2024 survey?

SELECT g.name, round(100 * (max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B23025_E005' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END)) / max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B23025_E003' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END), 1) AS pct_unemployed FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0400000US%' AND a.table_id = 'b23025' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What did New York households on full service pay per kilowatt hour in 2020, on average?

SELECT round(100 * sum(try_cast(revenues AS double)) / sum(try_cast(sales AS double)), 2) AS cents_per_kwh FROM govblock_energy.eia861_sales_ult_cust_sheet_states WHERE column00 = '2020' AND column03 = 'A' AND column06 = 'NY'
Which counties in California have the highest median home values?

SELECT g.name, try_cast(a.value AS double) AS median_value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 AS a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_5yr AS g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0500000US06%' AND a.variable = 'B25077_E001' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Do electricians earn more in New York or Texas?
SELECT area_title, a_median, h_median FROM govblock_labor.oes_all_data_m_sheet_a WHERE occ_title = 'Electricians' AND area_title IN ('New York', 'Texas') AND naics_title = 'Cross-industry' LIMIT 10
In which companies do doctors hold the most valuable ownership stakes?

SELECT applicable_manufacturer_or_applicable_gpo_making_payment_name, sum(try_cast(value_of_interest AS double)) AS value FROM govblock_health.op_ownership WHERE program_year = '2024' AND applicable_manufacturer_or_applicable_gpo_making_payment_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much did federal campaigns spend on travel in the 2016 cycle?
SELECT sum(transaction_amt) AS total FROM govblock_fec.operating_expenditures WHERE cast(cycle AS varchar) = '2016' AND category_desc LIKE 'Travel%'
What fed and drained the Highway Trust Fund in fiscal 2024?

SELECT account_desc, max(try_cast(fiscal_year_amt AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_treasury.highway_trust_fund_results WHERE fiscal_year = '2024' AND account_desc NOT LIKE 'Balance%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many chemistry patents were published in the United States in 2020?
SELECT count(*) AS patents FROM govblock_chemistry.surechembl_patents WHERE country = 'US' AND publication_date LIKE '2020%'
Which plumbing and heating contractors earned the most from federal work on Long Island since 2020?

SELECT recipient_name, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE naics_code = '238220' AND primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'NY' AND upper(primary_place_of_performance_county_name) IN ('NASSAU', 'SUFFOLK') AND action_date_fiscal_year >= '2020' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many urologists are enrolled in Medicare?
SELECT count(DISTINCT npi) AS clinicians FROM govblock_health.cc_dac_nationaldownloadablefile WHERE pri_spec = 'UROLOGY'
Which industries hold the most water discharge permits?
SELECT sic_desc, count(DISTINCT npdes_id) AS permits FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_sics GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
